The rewrite claimed restart-compliant behavior is 'shared by both backends,' which (a) contradicts this doc's own unchanged D4 row (legacy systemd never emits guard.compliant, any type) and (b) mischaracterizes wire delivery: legacy's in-process restart re-fire happens pre-network (start_local, before set_event_sink) and emit_guard_event drops unconditionally when no sink is wired - uncounted, no buffering (A3 unbuilt) - while spark's identical pre-network re-fire is buffered by GuardianOutbox specifically for this gap and reliably delivered post-connect.
